checked_obligation: Establishes the pointwise limit and shows that any possible uniform limit must be this function.
reason: For each x∈[0,1), 0≤x<1 implies x^n→0, while 1^n=1 for every n. Hence the pointwise limit is f(x)=0 for x<1 and f(1)=1. Uniform convergence implies pointwise convergence, and pointwise limits are unique, so any uniform limit must equal f. The listed group-theoretic rules are inapplicable and unnecessary.
